db-wp8-gates.what: WP8's onboarding repair, the client-write reachability assertion and report configuration

db-r1-gates.what: the systemic repair: an answer is never lost to a finish (R1), and a provisioned person can sign in while a stranger cannot provision themselves (F-01..F-03)

db-bob01-gates.what: BOB-01's school structure functions (who may build a school's Bagian, Tingkat and Kelas, and every refusal's stable code) and the intake's M5a place and year rules; and BOB-08's structure integrity: nothing placed or granted in a deactivated place, a year near now, the national library not a school, and one way in

db-bob02-gates.what: BOB-02's lesson package: the sample workbook materialised whole, the structured-package confirmation, a failed save that undoes its confirmation, coded problems, who may prepare or confirm, and media upload authority; and BOB-11's staff preview of a school's unreleased media (F11-P04)

db-bob03-gates.what: BOB-03's release path: a school's course approved, created, frozen and published by the people the capabilities name, the release authored by the course's author, readiness measured at the seal, the revision's next version, and every refusal's stable code; and releases changing only through their functions (D-041)

db-bob04-gates.what: BOB-04's whole learning cycle: a course carrying its pre-test and post-test, one assignment making both, the draw following the marks, INV-24 checked at assignment, every refusal's stable code, and a stranger refused the cycle; and the upload refusing a parallel group that spans both tests (D-040)

db-bob06-gates.what: BOB-06's standard reports: every school carries PINTAR's class and school reports from creation, in the standard assembly, and PINTAR's rows and the provisioning pass are nobody else's
